rules.title: Boston fair housing protection for renters using rental assistance (source of income)
rules.requirement: Discrimination in renting based on rental assistance is illegal in Boston. Rental assistance includes Section 8 vouchers, social security disability vouchers and veterans vouchers. A landlord who says they do not accept rental assistance is given as an example of housing discrimination. Complaints go to the Fair Housing Commission.

coverage.summary: Applies to renting, buying, selling or financing housing in the City of Boston. The page states no unit, size or age limits.

rules.quoted_span: The landlord tells you they don't accept rental assistance.
rules.review_note: The page is a general overview and names no ordinance or code section. The citation is the page's own title and should be confirmed against the Boston City Code. No effective date is stated.
rules.source_notes: Official city web page that summarizes enforcement of local, state and federal fair housing law.

result.doc_summary: Boston Fair Housing Commission overview page. It lists the protected classes under Boston fair housing law, including rental assistance such as Section 8 vouchers. It gives examples of discrimination and explains how to file a complaint. The page states no rent, eviction, deposit, fee or algorithmic pricing rules. The only extractable rule is the source-of-income protection, which falls under screening restrictions.
